sources.summary: The model tells all in her highly entertaining, eyebrow-raising documentary. Plus, revisiting a classic Play for Today. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Sky Documentaries Twenty years before Taylor and Travis’s stadium wedding bonanza, there was Katie Price and Peter Andre’s fairytale ceremony – or, as Kerry Katona puts it, “like Cinderella on coke and speed on a seven-day bender”. The third episode of Price’s documentary focuses on the marriage she says provided the best years of her life … until it didn’t. “I’d love you to interview Pete,” she says. “The chances are zero.” And she’s right.
